ecosystem: Ondo / Ethereum and BNB Chain tokenized-RWA distribution

evidence.catalyst: Ondo launched BLKHIon, BLKDIGon and BLKGRWon, portfolio tokens based on BlackRock-developed portfolio strategies, with transferability/composability for eligible non-U.S. investors.
evidence.market_response: At the checkpoint ONDO was approximately $0.5168, +24.6% over 24h and +39.5% over 7d, with about $887M 24h turnover versus about $2.52B market cap.
evidence.rwa_classification: Product issuance/access and composability were confirmed. Meaningful secondary turnover in the three new portfolio tokens and actual borrowing/collateral utilization were not yet verified, so no RWA secondary/utilization confirmation credit was awarded.
evidence.wallet_quality: Medium only. A whale-flow source reported 86 tracked ONDO whale wallets over 30d, about $63.6M accumulation-side versus $36.0M distribution, net +$27.6M; beneficial-owner independence, funding relationships and historical selectivity were not established.
evidence.token_value_capture: No direct fee/buyback/burn linkage from the newly launched portfolio products into ONDO was established at this checkpoint.

structural_gate.reason: Supply/control concentration. Ondo Foundation identified 0x677FD4Ed8aE623f2f625DEB2D64F2070E46cA1A1 as a Foundation-controlled locked-ONDO wallet. A contemporaneous rich-list snapshot showed that address at approximately 5.179B ONDO, 51.79% of the 10B supply, with top ten addresses around 67.55%. This fails the portfolio's hard supply/control concentration gate.

uncertainties: Actual minted AUM in BLKHIon/BLKDIGon/BLKGRWon was not yet established.
Secondary turnover and collateral/borrowing utilization were not yet established.
Whale-wallet independence and historical selectivity were not established.
Direct ONDO holder value capture from the new products was not established.
why_it_matters_now: Ondo crossed the ecosystem/product leadership threshold, but ONDO itself was structurally ineligible. The observation preserves the distinction between an attractive RWA product ecosystem and a token that fails the hard concentration gate.
forward_tests: Measure actual minted AUM in the three portfolio products.
Measure genuine secondary turnover and organic wallet diversity.
Track persistence and independence of ONDO accumulation after the catalyst spike.
Track movement and governance of Foundation-controlled ONDO supply.
Require direct fee/buyback/burn or other holder value capture before reconsidering ONDO.
persistence_note: This record was created on 2026-09-28/29 as a retry after the original 2026-09-24 GitHub write failed. The observation timestamp and rationale preserve the information set stated at the original checkpoint; no trade is backdated and no later price performance is credited.
